title: U.S. scraps proposed $10,000 reporting rule for for crypto sent to private wallets
summary: FinCEN withdrew two proposals that had hung over self-custody and crypto mixers for years without ever taking effect.

title: Ethereum’s Glamsterdam test gets last-minute fix before major capacity jump
summary: One of Ethereum’s main validator clients updated its software hours before a Sepolia test that will raise the amount of work each block can hold to 200 million gas.

title: Bitcoin keeps getting rejected at $87,000 as stocks hover near records
summary: BTC fell back to about $85,600 after sellers turned it away from $87,000 for the third time since Sept. 23, while Nasdaq closed at a record and Treasury yields kept climbing.

title: Solana Foundation unveils a program to settle institutional trades in seconds. JPMorgan gave input
summary: Solana Foundation launched an open-source program that lets institutions settle trades in seconds, not days. JPMorgan provided key inputs.

title: Crypto's campaign arm, Fairshake, sets lists of U.S. House favorites it'll spend on
summary: The super PAC shared a list of more than 30 incumbent candidates it's backing, with about a million dollars going to three names from each party.

title: More than 60 U.S. stocks including Nvidia and Tesla are headed onchain. Here’s how it works
summary: The planned 24/7 venue will offer dozens of tokenized U.S. stocks, with trades conducted against stablecoins through blockchain-based liquidity pools rather than a traditional order book.

title: U.S. CFTC joins SEC in proposing crypto regulations, though spot-market gap lingers
summary: The derivatives regulator is proposing two rules meant to cover the waterfront of crypto activity and exchanges, as long as it's not simple, direct trading.

title: Stripe to expand stablecoin cards to over 100 countries by the end of the year
summary: The payments giant is planning a major global expansion for its stablecoin cards business, and is exploring tokenized deposits and DeFi use cases, new crypto head Henri Stern said.

title: Better Markets says CFTC is ‘wrong agency’ to regulate retail crypto
summary: Better Markets said the CFTC’s proposed framework to bring certain cryptocurrency transactions and exchanges under its oversight will leave investors less protected than under the SEC.

title: Rain seeks US trust bank charter days after OCC sued over crypto charters
summary: Rain joins a growing queue of crypto firms seeking federal trust charters, while community banks have just asked a court to overturn the OCC rules underpinning them.

title: OKX eyes emerging markets with yield-offering stablecoin savings and payments app
summary: OKX Money lets users hold, send and spend dollar-backed stablecoins, with qualifying USDG balances earning up to 10% APY.

title: Chinese crime network laundered over $1B for Lazarus: ZachXBT
summary: ZachXBT says he infiltrated the network by posing as a customer, gaining information that helped trace funds from the $1.5 billion Bybit hack.

title: Crypto PAC announces support for 32 House candidates in US midterms
summary: Fairshake said it would financially back 32 House candidates who all voted in favor of the CLARITY market structure bill in 2025, as the legislation remains in limbo in the Senate.

title: FinCEN withdraws proposed crypto mixing rule over ‘legitimate activity’ concerns
summary: The bureau under the US Treasury said it was withdrawing two proposed rules on unhosted wallets and crypto mixers ”as part of the Trump Administration’s deregulatory agenda.”

title: Modern Treasury seeks US trust bank charter for digital asset custody
summary: The payments infrastructure company is seeking federal approval to offer stablecoin custody and related fiat services through a limited-purpose national trust bank.

title: Advocacy group pushes back on banks’ lawsuit against OCC over charters
summary: CCI CEO Ji Hun Kim said that the organization “remains confident“ in the OCC’s approval of charters for crypto companies, despite a recent lawsuit and pushback from some lawmakers.

title: Solana Debuts Institutional Settlement Standard With J.P. Morgan Input
summary: Built with input from J.P. Morgan, the open-source "DvP" program lets institutions settle trades atomically on Solana with finality in seconds instead of days.

title: Strive Adds $169M Bitcoin in Its Biggest Buy in Four Months
summary: The Nasdaq-listed bitcoin treasury company, co-founded by Vivek Ramaswamy, paid roughly $169 million for 2,000 coins last week and now holds 29,462 BTC.

title: DeFi Development Corp Adds $3 Million in Solana as SOL Buys Slow
summary: Nasdaq-listed DeFi Development Corp's latest SEC filing shows its Solana stash grew 1%, to about 2.56 million SOL and SOL equivalents—roughly half the prior week's gain and well below mid-September's pace.

title: A Florida Woman Used Claude as a Diary. An Anthropic Employee Read It and Reported It to Police
summary: Investigators say a Bonita Springs woman's Claude "diary" tripped Anthropic's safety filters. A human review team sent it to police, and Anthropic's own terms allow exactly that.

title: Why a 4chan Bitcoin Prophecy Says Today Is the End of Crypto Winter
summary: An anonymous 4chan user called Bitcoin's October 2025 peak to the day way back in 2023. Could they be right again?

title: Treasury Kills Crypto 'Unhosted Wallet' and Mixer Surveillance Rules
summary: FinCEN withdrew a 2020 proposal to track transactions with self-custodial crypto wallets and a 2023 plan to designate crypto mixing as a primary money laundering concern.

title: Crypto Sleuth ZachXBT Fronted $350K to Pose as a Client of Lazarus' Chinese Launderers
summary: The on-chain sleuth says he posed as a customer of a Chinese crime syndicate, fronting $349,700 and eating 5% on every order, to track Lazarus Group's Bybit loot in real time.

title: SEC Clears 3x Leveraged Bitcoin and Ethereum Funds for Trading
summary: The agency approved a Cboe rule letting six Volatility Shares funds that triple the daily moves of Bitcoin, Ethereum, gold, silver, oil, and natural gas list on a U.S. exchange.

title: Treasury withdraws crypto mixing rule, citing concerns over ‘chilling effect on legitimate activity’
summary: FinCEN is withdrawing a proposal that would've designated crypto mixing a "primary money laundering concern" under the PATRIOT Act.

title: Umia raises $6.1 million at $18 million FDV to help crypto projects launch tokens
summary: Umia raised $6.11 million through a seven-day auction of its UMIA token, with ten funds and nearly 700 individual bidders taking part.

title: CFTC proposes new federal framework for leveraged retail crypto trading
summary: The CFTC launched rulemaking on leveraged and margined retail crypto trading, proposing Regulation CTX and CAM and a new "crypto asset market" exchange.

title: Strive adds 2,000 bitcoin in biggest buy since June, closes in on MARA
summary: Strive’s bitcoin holdings near 30,000 BTC as the race among the largest public treasuries heats up.

title: DeFi Development sees NAV per share more than doubling, holds 2.56 million SOL
summary: DFDV says preliminary Q3 estimates show NAV per share more than doubled as its Solana treasury grew to 2.56 million SOL.

title: Tom Lee says ether ‘dwarfing other macro assets’ as Bitmine adds 15,112 ETH
summary: Bitmine added 15,112 ETH as Chairman Tom Lee said Ethereum outperformed the S&P 500 by 6,832 basis points in Q3.

title: ‘More orange than ever’: Michael Saylor’s Strategy buys 334 bitcoin for $28.7 million as total holdings top 848,000 BTC
summary: Strategy's total holdings account for around 4% of the 21 million bitcoin supply cap — worth roughly $73 billion.

title: Metaplanet sold 10,000 BTC in Q3 before buying back 11,000 BTC to ‘demonstrate liquidity’
summary: Metaplanet added a net 1,000 BTC during the third quarter as its total bitcoin holdings reached 44,000 BTC.
